title: The new hazardous jobs and worker reallocation
title_zh: 新危险职业与工人再配置
authors: Gaetano Basso, Tito Boeri, Alessandro Caiumi, Marco Paccagnella, Mario Daniele Amore 等
official: 官方在线 2020-07-26 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyses several dimensions of workers’ safety that are relevant in the context of a pandemic. We provide a classification of occupations according to the risk of contagion: by considering a wider range of job characteristics and a more nuanced assessment of infection risk, we expand on the previous literature that almost exclusively looked at feasibility of working from home. We apply our classification to the United States and to European countries and we find that roughly 50% of jobs in our sample can be considered safe, although a large cross-country variation exists, notably in the potential incidence of remote working. We find that the most economically vulnerable workers (low-educated, low-wage workers, immigrants, workers on temporary contracts, and part-timers) are over-represented in unsafe jobs, notably in non-essential activities. We assess the nature of the reallocation of workers from unsafe to safe jobs that is likely to take place in the years to come, and the policies that could mitigate the social cost of this reallocation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在疫情背景下与工人安全相关的几个维度。我们根据传染风险对职业进行了分类：通过考虑更广泛的工作特征和更细致的感染风险评估，我们扩展了先前几乎仅关注居家办公可行性的文献。我们将此分类应用于美国和欧洲国家，发现样本中约50%的工作可视为安全，尽管各国之间存在显著差异，尤其是在远程工作的潜在普及率方面。我们发现，经济上最脆弱的工人（低教育程度、低工资工人、移民、临时合同工及兼职者）在不安全工作中占比过高，尤其是在非必要活动中。我们评估了未来几年可能发生的工人从不安全工作向安全工作重新配置的性质，以及可能减轻这一重新配置社会成本的政策。

title: Authoritarian Propaganda and Social Networks
authors: Konstantin Sonin, Yixin Mei, Yanhui Wu, Alex Cukierman
official: 官方在线 2025-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Information manipulation is a powerful tool in the hands of any authoritarian leader. Dictators block independent media, censor news, pay influencers, and control citizens' social connections. In our model, citizens acquire information from censored sources or through social networks. Naturally, information manipulation has less impact when consuming news is costly and percolation in the network is low. Less intuitively, it might be optimal for the regime to target peripheral, rather than centrally connected citizens, and the propaganda's maximum impact is when percolation of information is close to zero (the society is atomized) or close to one, but not in-between.
abstract_zh: 信息操纵是任何威权领导者手中的强大工具。独裁者封锁独立媒体、审查新闻、收买舆论影响者，并控制公民的社会联系。在我们的模型中，公民通过受审查的渠道或社交网络获取信息。自然，当新闻消费成本高昂且信息在网络中的渗透率较低时，信息操纵的影响较小。而更反直觉的是，政权可能更倾向于针对边缘化而非核心社交联系的公民进行操纵，且宣传的最大影响力出现在信息渗透率接近零（社会原子化）或接近一时，而非介于两者之间。

title: Using AI to Let History Speak About Bank Runs
title_zh: 利用人工智能让历史讲述银行挤兑
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Banking crises are commonly associated with bank runs and banking panics, yet our empirical understanding of bank runs is constrained by a lack of bank-level data. In a new paper, we use large language models (LLMs) to extract information on bank runs from millions of digitized historical newspaper pages, creating the most comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history. Every bank run episode that we identify is documented on a companion website where users can browse and examine individual episodes, and read the original newspaper articles. In this post, we describe how we built this dataset and discuss what its basic features reveal.
abstract_zh: 银行危机通常与银行挤兑和银行业恐慌相关联，然而我们对银行挤兑的实证理解受限于缺乏银行层面的数据。在一篇新论文中，我们利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从数百万页数字化历史报纸中提取银行挤兑信息，构建了美国历史上最全面的银行挤兑数据库。我们识别的每一次银行挤兑事件均记录在配套网站上，用户可浏览和查阅单个事件，并阅读原始报纸文章。本文中，我们描述了如何构建该数据集，并探讨其基本特征所揭示的信息。

title: Technology Transfer and Early Industrial Development: Evidence from the Sino-Soviet Alliance
title_zh: 技术转移与早期工业发展：来自中苏联盟的证据
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的工业集群。这些项目包含技术转移（通过提供苏联最先进的机械设备）和知识转移（通过苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管及高级技工）。我们利用新汇编的跨越四十余年的钢铁厂数据，并借助这些工厂最终获得转移项目的自然差异进行分析。研究发现：若缺乏配套培训，源自苏联技术的生产优势会逐渐消退；而知识转移对工厂绩效具有持久影响，在中国封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国融入国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。此外，知识转移还对配套企业产生了生产率与技术溢出效应。

title: On the Optimality of Full Disclosure
Dynamic Complementarity
authors: Heckman, James, Tian, Haihan, Zhang, Zijian, Zhou, Jin, Heckman, James J.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at an age, promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and produce evidence on dynamic complementarity and its three components using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.
abstract_zh: 动态互补性是指过去投资在某个年龄段形成更高技能存量，从而促进该年龄段投资带来的技能增长这一概念。我们利用中国农村地区针对幼儿家长的家访项目独特数据，对动态互补性及其三个组成部分进行了界定并提供了实证证据。此外，我们还研究了在没有任何正式干预的情况下，由先天因素、父母因素和环境因素导致的学习增长。
